name: 3S Auto-Raid (classic, MIP)
author: Joakim
description: 3Scapes auto-raid: dispatch docked longships to a target town (solo or convoy). CLASSIC: fed by the MIP viking feed (vik.* state) — for 3Scapes with MIP on; the Viking guild does not exist on 3K. The maintained GMCP line is '3S Auto-Raid (GMCP)' (3s-raid-gmcp). So both can load at once, this classic answers to 'araidc' instead of 'araid'. Otherwise frozen.
